# ExplorerKit

> ExplorerKit embeds Servo, a web engine built for embedding, in native apps, like CEF. Where Servo isn't ready yet, a view can use the platform's own web view through a compatibility layer behind the same API; public APIs are designed for Servo first. Apps own windows, tabs, and layout; a Rust core owns browser logic (commands, events, page prompts) for Servo views and the iOS adapter; thin adapters connect Rust, Android/Kotlin, and React Native. Today: Servo or the system web view per view on macOS (Rust), Servo on Android, WKWebView on iOS. Experimental; nothing is published yet.

Paths are relative to the repository root. Agents working in this repository must also follow AGENTS.md and the AGENTS.md file in the folder they change.

## Platforms

- [React Native](docs/platforms/react-native.md): `<ExplorerView>` props, events, methods, navigation policy, dialogs, JavaScript evaluation, context menus

- [Desktop (Rust)](docs/platforms/desktop.md): Embedding with the `explorerkit` crate, `winit` and GPUI examples, known limits

- [Runtime and views](docs/concepts/runtime.md): One engine per process, Runtime, sessions, web views, threads, profiles, popups

- [Commands, events, and page prompts](docs/concepts/controller.md): The JSON command envelope, prompt flow, fallbacks, transports, status codes
